probability_threshold_for_other_draft_pa.behavior: Standard/Eagle-style and non-DSpark DFlash draft paths stop adding tokens when the sampled top probability is below params.p_min. p_min defaults to 0.0, and the CLI flag is --spec-draft-p-min. This is a per-token probability early-stop, not a DFlash2 adaptive scheduler.
probability_threshold_for_other_draft_pa.exact_scope: The DFlash2 branch is earlier and continues to its fixed block loop; these p_min checks do not apply to it.

dspark_confidence_head.behavior: DSpark builds a sigmoid per-position confidence head (conf_proj over hidden/Markov features), exposes it through nextn embeddings, and truncates at the first confidence below params.p_min. This is an existing confidence-gated length mechanism, but it is explicitly the draft-dspark type, not draft-dflash/DFlash2.
dspark_confidence_head.disposition: Relevant precedent only; not evidence that PLAN/PQ DFlash2 has an adaptive selector.
